messages:
Sam: Quick proposal — replace ad-hoc pin fields with a small 'placement_token' + explicit lease model to avoid orphan pins. Sketch:

```
{
  "schema_version": "2",
  "placement_token": "pt-123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
  "lease_until": "2026-05-01T17:00:00Z",
  "actor": "console",
  "preferred_variants": ["gptx-v1", "gptx-q4"],
  "soft_swap": true,
  "grace_window_s": 30
}
```

Purpose: explicit short-lived leases so evictions are automatic and pins are auditable. WDYT?

Anya: +1 on explicit leases. Two concerns: SDK compatibility and how older agents interpret unknown fields. We should default to v1 behavior if schema_version missing. :eyes:

Matt: Runtime note — we only need a token + ordered preference list + soft_swap. Suggest rename affinity -> preferred_variants to avoid nested semantics. Keep fields flat for faster routing.

Rajesh: DB / infra: store as jsonb is fine. We'll need indexes on placement_token and lease_until for TTL queries. Plan a small TTL sweeper that marks expired tokens and writes an event. Also watch cardinality if every request writes renewal.

Liz: Console UX: show active expiry and allow renew/extend. Renewal flow must validate RBAC (who can extend). Also show provenance (actor/origin).

Kate: Rollout semantics question: during canary we may intentionally keep a variant offline. If soft_swap=false we should fail fast; if true allow fallback. Also want a backoff policy when fallback used to avoid thrashing.

Sam: Good point. Add soft_swap (bool) + grace_window_s (int). Runtime will try preferred_variants in order, if none available and soft_swap=true then fall back to named default after grace_window_s. If soft_swap=false return pin-error.

deploy-bot: Note: ANY schema bump implies servers should be tolerant — accept unknown fields and ignore them until feature flag flips. Recommend server-side parsing behind feature flag and gradual rollout.

infra-bot: Telemetry: emit events lease_created / lease_renewed / lease_expired and a metric for eviction_rate. Also log origin and actor for billing/audit.

Olivia: Longer term I'd like to deprecate the word 'pin' from APIs and rename to 'placement_token' across SDKs, routes, and console. Suggest dual support for 6 months with deprecation warnings in SDKs.

Matt: Also add an 'origin' field: e.g., "origin": "user:team-x" or "system:auto" for cost attribution and audit.

Sam: Action items: 1) draft migration RFC for schema_v2 (Liz + Rajesh), 2) runtime tolerant parsing + feature flag (Matt + Sam), 3) SDK warnings + dual API support (Anya + Olivia), 4) DB indices + TTL sweeper (Rajesh). I'll open the RFC draft today.

Kate: +1. Can we have a 30m sync tomorrow to align on TTL behavior and graceful failure semantics?

Sam: Yep — scheduling now. Thanks all. :tada:
